text:
alana: Quick sync: proposing new add-on 'Elastic Reserve' (Dedicated only) to handle predictable bursts for launch days. Key asks from customers: clear per-route caps, an included burst pool, and simple pricing math. Need pilot plan + non-negotiables before we evangelize.

kevin: Tech constraints: we can do reserve_units assigned to tenant queues and a shared cluster burst pool. Recommend two SKUs: Elastic-Reserve-Base (reserve_units x2 compute) and Elastic-Reserve-Plus (reserve_units x3 + monthly burst_tokens). Sample knobs: `reserve_units=2500`, `tenant_hard_qps=reserve_units*1`, `burst_tokens_month=150000`, `burst_window_sec=600`. Must implement cluster-level policing if many tenants burst.

sara-sales: Sales wants very simple examples in pricing doc. Propose: Elastic-Reserve-Base: $3,000/mo (2x throughput) Elastic-Reserve-Plus: $8,000/mo (3x throughput + 150k burst tokens). Overage: $0.06 per 1k tokens equivalent. Pilot offer: 40% off month 1 + 75k trial burst tokens. Keep negotiation levers = commit length, included tokens, and support SLA. Non-negotiable = unlimited burst. :no_entry_sign:

ben-ops: Operational checklist: UI for remaining burst balance, billing meter, telemetry: er.qps, er.burst_tokens_used, er.fallback_count, er.cluster_throttle. Alerts when cluster pool < 20%. Runbook: if cluster pool exhausted, automatically fallback to standard lane and send incident to ops. Retention: 45d logs for pilot.

contracts-bot: Contracts note: define "burst token" precisely: mapping to compute-units or token-equivalent depending on model. Clause should read: "Burst tokens indicate prioritized routing and are not a guarantee of absolute capacity; provider may throttle to preserve platform stability." Any SLA uplift requires legal approval and customer commit-anchor.

kevin: Technical nit: converting tokens -> compute-units is better for mixed-model customers. I'll propose a CU conversion table in the billing spec. Also need feature flag `elastic_reserve` and admin override for emergency reclamation.

sara-sales: Pilot criteria: 1) two signed pilots with billing set, 2) console quota UI + meter, 3) telemetry + alerting, 4) legal-approved burst clause, 5) internal runbook and post-mortem template. Target pilot start: 3 weeks.

infra-bot: NOTE: feature-flag "elastic_reserve" enabled in staging. Integration tests running.

alana: Decision points for negotiation doc: a) included burst tokens (yes/no), b) overage rate band, c) minimum commit for Plus tier. Sales to start outreach to three likely pilots: BrightApps, NovaPay, and PixelLabs.

ben-ops: Add to checklist: billing SKU names `elastic_reserve.base` and `elastic_reserve.plus`, meter `er.burst_tokens_used`, and invoice metadata to include `commit_anchor` when discount applies.

kevin: Engineering caveat: simultaneous large bursts may require temporary global clamp. We'll ship cluster policing and an emergency throttle policy for GA.

alana: If no objections, I'll lock the pilot pricing and hand to contracts tomorrow. Please raise any concerns in next 12h. Thanks! :rocket:
